title: Prove installed execution and refinement starts in Node Vitest

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** For `SEED-413#prove-installed-story-starts-on-vitest` at `5ebbb46662fa87ce2835269bf47dc7f9dfbb4058`, the migrated Node Vitest case catches an established execution start whose published Take omits the requested model.

The queued-ready private-origin fixture requests Claude with model `opus`. The scratch fault removed `model: agent.model` from the installed `stageAgentProfile` call to `renderAgentProfile` in `Distribution/src/skills/dough-execute-plan/scripts/workspace-publication-claim.mjs:49`. The fixture and maintained assertions were unchanged. A separate Node invocation of the typed start independently read the bare origin with Git. Both before and during the fault, Start reported `established`, and the private trunk, the published story branch and the handoff SHA agreed. The baseline trunk profile contained `model: "opus"`. The faulted trunk profile lacked the `model` field.

The same focused command ran before the fault, with the fault and after restoration:

```sh
caffeinate -s -i env -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES -u OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_BACKEND_SPLIT -u FORCE_COLOR -u NO_COLOR npm run test:dashboard:backend -- 'launches/agent-launch-start\.spec\.ts$' --workers=1 -g 'publishes the Take and keeps the handoff \(opus model\)'
```

The first run passed. The faulted run reached the published-profile assertion in `dashboard/backend-tests/launches/agent-launch-start.spec.ts:111` and failed with `expected undefined to be 'opus'`. After restoring the source, the detached checkout matched its initial clean state and the same case passed again. The scratch worktree was removed. Logs, the fault diff, and both Git observations are retained under `/tmp/dough-847-intent.nZAdLi/`.

**Next proof action.** Keep the maintained assertion for the published named model. The check calls for no additional proof for this fault.

- **Test runtime.** 18.09 seconds measured by Vitest across the focused baseline, faulted and restored runs (7.20, 5.09 and 5.80 seconds).
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. The invocation recorded no separate human-effort timing.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No separate active-effort meter was used.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 162986 ms (measured), from 1795660789696 to 1795660952682 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition — `5ebbb46662fa87ce2835269bf47dc7f9dfbb4058`, Caught, no follow-up.
